title: Switching Fundamentals Quiz
description: Test your knowledge of MAC address tables, VLANs, trunking and spanning tree.

questions.prompt: How does a switch build its MAC address table?

options.text: It is manually configured by an administrator
It learns the source MAC address of incoming frames
It queries a central MAC server
It copies the ARP table from connected hosts

questions.explanation: A switch records the source MAC address and the ingress port of each frame, building the table dynamically.

questions.prompt: What does an 802.1Q tag add to an Ethernet frame?
questions.explanation: 802.1Q inserts a 4-byte tag containing the 12-bit VLAN ID and priority information.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of Spanning Tree Protocol (STP)?

options.text: To prevent Layer 2 loops by blocking redundant paths

questions.explanation: STP creates a loop-free topology by placing redundant ports into a blocking state.
